notes.title: Sun Blast Update - June 1st 2015
notes.content:
We would like to thank everyone for the interest in Sun Blast.
Based on your feedback, we have made several updates to the game:


 Released the Linux version on Steam

 Extended controller support
In addition to the Wii Remote, the game can now be played with regular joysticks and gamepads.
 - Added controller configuration screen. You can set your own mapping and adjust the sensitivity.
 - Built-in support for Xbox 360 Controller. Just plug it in and start the game.
 
 Resolution setup improvements
